create_pipeline_class: create the Ollama Pipeline class that interfaces with Ollama's chat completions API
run_pipeline_pipe: run the pipe method to forward chat messages to Ollama's /v1/chat/completions endpoint
test_pipeline_startup: test the on_startup lifecycle hook of the Ollama Pipeline class

review_pipeline_streaming: review the pipe method to handle both streaming and non-streaming responses from Ollama
